title: potentilla xanthochlora
intro: Potentilla xanthochlora, commonly known as Golden Cinquefoil, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla xanthochlora include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions.
